# GuiaFlow

> GuiaFlow (guiaflow.pro) is an open source (MIT) editor that turns screenshots and photos into presentations people explore at their own pace: step-by-step interactive guides (product demos, product tours, software training) and photo galleries (products, catalogs, vehicles). The editor runs in the browser for free, with no account and no credit card. Free use includes the "Create with help" assistant, AI text and narration with your own AI key, 7-day temporary links, HTML/video export and a WhatsApp or link button at the end, with no project limit. GuiaFlow Pro (the paid Pro plan; subscribe directly: US$ 7/month or US$ 69/year; R$ 36/month or R$ 359/year in Brazil) adds permanent links that never expire, embeds, lead capture, analytics, hosted AI and narration, watermark-free video and an MCP server / REST API for AI agents. Interface in Portuguese, English and Spanish.

GuiaFlow (guiaflow.pro) is not Guideflow (guideflow.com); they are different products.

## Plans

- Free (no account): full editor in the browser; no project limit, projects stored only in this browser; temporary links (/v/...) that last 7 days; HTML and MP4 export (the video and the player carry the GuiaFlow mark); WhatsApp or link at the end; AI and narration with your own key (OpenRouter, OpenAI or compatible for text; Cartesia for voice); "Create with help" assistant (works without AI, too).
- Pro plan (subscribe directly on the site, billed via Stripe, cancel anytime; no sales call): everything in Free + permanent links (/p/...) with cover image that never expire, projects synced to the cloud, contact capture and contact form (optional, with consent), embed on websites, analytics (opens, completions, end-button clicks, drop-off by step), hosted AI and narration (100 texts and 30 audio minutes per month), player and video without the GuiaFlow mark, a "Clients" area to organize projects by client (name and logo) inside the editor (not white-label: the client logo does not appear in the player), MCP server and REST API. Temporary 7-day links are also available on Pro. Not white-label: links stay on guiaflow.pro and the player shows no custom logo.
- Subscribe to Pro: https://guiaflow.pro/editor?pro=1 · Prices: https://guiaflow.pro/en#precos · Terms: https://guiaflow.pro/en/terms

## What GuiaFlow does not do

- No in-app onboarding (no script inside your product), no HTML clone of the interface, no blurring of sensitive data, no branching (guided tours are linear; gallery mode allows free navigation), no custom domain, no SSO.

## Connect

- MCP server (Streamable HTTP): https://app.guiaflow.pro/mcp
- Auth: OAuth 2.1 with PKCE (dynamic client registration and Client ID Metadata Documents supported; discovery at https://app.guiaflow.pro/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp), or an API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer gf_live_...` (created in the editor: account menu -> API keys).
- Scopes: `tours:read`, `tours:write`, `publish`, `ai` (GuiaFlow AI text and narration; uses the user's monthly quota), `analytics:read` (link stats, counts only).
- REST API base: https://app.guiaflow.pro/v1 (same auth). OpenAPI: https://app.guiaflow.pro/v1/openapi.json

## Docs

- [API and MCP guide](https://guiaflow.pro/ajuda/api): setup for Cursor, Claude Code, Claude.ai, ChatGPT, VS Code; tools; limits.
- [Integrations](https://guiaflow.pro/integracoes): one-click install for Cursor and VS Code, steps for Claude Code, Claude.ai and ChatGPT.
- [Lead recipes](https://guiaflow.pro/integracoes/leads): send each tour contact to Pipefy, Google Sheets or Pipedrive with Make, n8n or Zapier (trigger Webhooks by Zapier). Importable scenario files and a Standard Webhooks signature check.
- [LeadPronto integration](https://guiaflow.pro/integracoes/leadpronto): connect the GuiaFlow account to LeadPronto with OAuth so each demo lead lands in the WhatsApp funnel with the tour, source and UTMs (Pro).
- [OpenAPI 3.1](https://app.guiaflow.pro/v1/openapi.json): REST contract (includes `POST /v1/tours/{id}/steps/{stepId}/generate-text`, `POST .../narration`, `GET /v1/tours/{id}/analytics`, `GET /v1/analytics`).
- [Help](https://guiaflow.pro/ajuda): recording screenshots with the Chrome extension and editing tours.
- [Privacy](https://guiaflow.pro/privacidade)

## How to build a tour (MCP tools)

1. `create_tour` {name, template?, mode?} -> tourId. The tour appears in the user's editor tagged "created by agent". `template` starts the tour with a mode and suggested scene names: `"empreendimento"` (real estate: Fachada, Lazer, Plantas, Localização), `"veiculo"` (vehicles: Exterior, Interior, Detalhes, Ficha técnica) and `"produto"` (products / e-commerce / catalogs: Visão geral, Detalhes, Em uso, Medidas e variações) start in gallery mode; `"software"` (default) starts guided. `mode` ("guided" | "gallery") overrides it. The response lists the scenes (`scaffold.scenes`, with what to photograph); use them as the `scene` number in `add_step`.
2. For each screenshot: `upload_media` {url | base64} -> mediaId (or call it with no args to get a 15-minute upload URL for a local file), then `add_step` {tourId, image: {mediaId}, title, text, highlight: {x,y,width,height}, click: {x,y}}. `text` (balloon text, also slide and start/end card body) accepts light formatting markers: `**bold**`, `*italic*`, `++underline++` and lines starting with `- ` (one-level list); no HTML, no links. Title and narration script are plain text.
3. Optional: `set_theme`, `set_lead_capture` (opening step asking name/email/phone with consent), `set_end_cta` (WhatsApp in E.164 like +5511999998888 and/or an https link).
4. Optional AI (scope `ai`, uses the user's quota of 100 texts and 30 audio minutes per month): `generate_step_text` {tourId, stepId, instructions?, language?, narrationScript?} looks at the screenshot and writes title/text into the step; `generate_narration` {tourId, stepId, text?} saves a mono 64 kbps MP3 as the step audio.
5. `publish` {tourId, dryRun: true} to validate and get `preview.url` (a temporary preview link valid for 7 days, show it to the user), then `publish` {tourId} -> permanent URL + embed HTML + cover image (og:image) rendered on the server. Publishing again updates the same link.
6. Later: `get_analytics` {tourId?, from?, to?} -> views, completions, CTA clicks, lead count, daily series and per-step funnel (scope `analytics:read`).

Video step: `add_step`/`update_step` accept `video` = a YouTube or Vimeo URL (link only, nothing is uploaded). The server downloads the video cover as the step image unless you send `image`; the step fills the frame (highlight/click are ignored) and the player loads YouTube/Vimeo only when the viewer clicks play. `video: null` removes it.
Display mode: `set_display_mode` {tourId, mode?, stickyWhatsAppFromStep?, sceneNames?}. `mode: "guided"` (default) is the guided tour with balloons, highlights, autoplay and narration. `mode: "gallery"` is a full-screen photo carousel for photo-first tours (real estate, vehicles, products, catalogs): swipe/arrows, counter "N of M", one-line caption with "Details", zoom for floor plans, section chips from scene names, thumbnails, video steps as click-to-play. Balloons, highlights, autoplay and narration are off in gallery. `stickyWhatsAppFromStep` (1 = first step, 0 = off) shows a fixed WhatsApp button that uses the `set_end_cta` number. `sceneNames` {"1": "Fachada", "2": "Lazer"} names the `scene` numbers of the steps (gallery sections). The user can switch the mode in the editor (gear menu → "Modo de exibição", or the Preview menu).
Other tools: `list_tours`, `get_tour`, `update_step`, `reorder_steps`, `delete_step`, `unpublish` (needs confirm: true).

## Format rules

- Coordinates are fractions of the image: x, y, width, height in 0..1 from the top-left corner. Click is kept inside the highlight; with only a click, a highlight is drawn around it. Out-of-range values are clamped and reported as warnings.
- Step `type: "slide"` is a text card without an image.
- Limits: title 120 chars, text 1200, narration script 3000, 200 steps, images up to 15 MB (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF), published tour up to 12 MB (prefer JPEG/WebP).
- Rate limits: 60 calls/min per key or app; 600 writes and 30 publishes per hour per account. Errors: 401 invalid/revoked credential, 402 no Pro plan, 403 missing scope, 429 with Retry-After.
- Send `Idempotency-Key` on REST POSTs to retry safely.
